description: Known unitary, compact, bosonic 2d CFTs with 1 < c <= 3/2 and Delta_gap <= 3/5. c and gap are exact fractions, c_float and gap_float their float values. Delta_gap is the dimension of the lowest non-vacuum Virasoro primary of any spin. Fig. 1 draws each entry of marks as a grey cross at (c - 1, gap) in its right panel, and c_3_2_segment as a grey bar; the entries of c_3_2_points lie on that bar and are not drawn separately. Theories whose gap is known only as a bracket are not listed and not drawn.
scope_note: Every listed theory has a conserved current beyond the stress tensor (spin 1 or 2 for products and the c = 3/2 lines, higher-spin currents in the bosonized N=1 models, W-algebra currents in the parafermion theories), so none satisfies the twist-gap assumption of the certified exclusions. The marks show where explicit theories sit; they do not test the dual bounds.

fields.c, gap: exact central charge and gap, as fractions
fields.c_float, gap_float: the same as floats (what the figure plots, with x = c_float - 1)
fields.families: construction classes that produce the point, keys of family_names
fields.labels: the constructions that give the point (several where a point arises in several ways)

label_shorthand: M(p,q) Virasoro minimal model; TCI tricritical Ising; SM or MM superconformal minimal model; (A,A), (A,D), (D,A), (A,E) modular-invariant types; Bos[sigma] and Bos[Gsigma] the two bosonizations of a fermionic N=1 model; ext and aut extension and automorphism invariants; /Z2diag diagonal Z2 gauging; /C charge-conjugation orbifold; G_k/H coset; SC J order n h_J X: the simple current J, of order n and weight h_J (X = h_J mod 1), that builds the invariant

c_3_2_segment.note: the c = 3/2 continuous families fill 0 < gap <= 3/8; drawn as a grey bar at c - 1 = 0.5
